raw_segments.text: Passapart out went on his errand enchanted. He soon reached the clergyman's house, but found him not at home.
Passapart out waited a good 20 minutes, and when he left the Reverend Gentlemen, it was 35 minutes past eight.
But in what a state he was. With his hair in disorder, and without his hat,
he ran along the street as never man was seen to run before,
overturning passers-by, rushing over the sidewalk like a waterspout.
